QuestInfo.name: Truth of the Rumor-Betty
QuestInfo.0: Let's ask #b#p511##k in #m10004000# if there's anyone who might know more.
QuestInfo.1: Let's ask botanist #b#p308##k in #m10002000# about the rumor.

0.0: That's as much as I can tell you. Come to think of it... #b#p308##k in #m10002000# may know a good deal more. She is a botanist, after all.

yes.0: But let me say this once more. Sometimes, simply letting things pass is the answer.

no.0: Indeed. But no one would blame you for it.

1.0: Welcome. How can I help you?\r\n#b#L0#Do you know anything about a ghost tree?#l
1.1: You must be helping Doctor #p512#'s research, right? Well, I did a bit of research myself after he asked me, but I didn't get much. The only thing I figured out was that the forest on the border between #m10004000# and #m10002000# is drying up very quickly. It may not look so fast from the surface, but it is very drastic.\r\n#b#L0#Indeed. Thank you very much for your time.#l
1.2: I'm sorry I can't be of much help.
